hadi-march/data#configure.name: configure
hadi-march/data#configure.doc: Change global defaults: `configure({ retry: 1, onError: (e) => toast.error(e.message) })`.
hadi-march/data#configure.tr: Genel varsayılanları değiştirir: `configure({ retry: 1, onError: (e) => toast.error(e.message) })`.

hadi-march/data#countLabel.name: countLabel
hadi-march/data#countLabel.signature: function countLabel(n: number, max: number = 99): string

hadi-march/data#fetchJson.name: fetchJson
hadi-march/data#fetchJson.doc: fetch() wrapper: JSON in/out, errors carry `status` and the server's message.
hadi-march/data#fetchJson.signature: function fetchJson<T = unknown>(url: string | URL, __1: FetchJsonOptions = {}): Promise<T>
hadi-march/data#fetchJson.tr: fetch() sarmalayıcısı: JSON giriş/çıkış, hatalar `status` ve sunucu iletisini taşır.

hadi-march/data#Gate.name: Gate
hadi-march/data#Gate.doc: Like <Can>, but meant for whole screens: `fallback(reason, requirement)` explains what is missing (e.g. "this screen needs phone sign-in"). Props: perm, role, method, auth.

props.name: fallback
props.doc: Content, or `(reason, requirement) => content`.

hadi-march/data#Gate.tr: <Can> gibi ama tüm ekranlar için: `fallback(reason, requirement)` eksik olanı açıklar (örn. "bu ekran telefonla giriş ister"). Proplar: perm, role, method, auth.

hadi-march/data#groupRows.name: groupRows
hadi-march/data#groupRows.doc: Group `rows` by `levels` (in order, stable: groups appear in the order of their first row, rows keep their order — sort first to order the groups). Returns the visible flat list: headers, then (when open) sub-groups or rows.
hadi-march/data#groupRows.signature: function groupRows<R>(rows: readonly R[], levels: readonly GroupLevel<R>[], o: GroupOptions<R> = {}): GroupItem<R>[]
hadi-march/data#groupRows.tr: `rows` satırlarını `levels` ile gruplar (sıralı ve kararlı: gruplar ilk satırlarının sırasıyla görünür, satırlar sırasını korur — grupları sıralamak için önce sıralayın). Görünür düz listeyi döndürür: başlıklar, açıksa alt gruplar ve satırlar.

hadi-march/data#hasMethod.name: hasMethod
hadi-march/data#hasMethod.doc: Does the user hold one of these sign-in methods (password, otp, passkey …)?
hadi-march/data#hasMethod.signature: function hasMethod(m: Method | readonly Method[]): boolean
hadi-march/data#hasMethod.tr: Kullanıcı bu oturum açma yöntemlerinden birine sahip mi (password, otp, passkey …)?

hadi-march/data#hasRole.name: hasRole
hadi-march/data#hasRole.doc: Does the user hold one of these roles?
hadi-march/data#hasRole.signature: function hasRole(r: RoleName | readonly RoleName[]): boolean
hadi-march/data#hasRole.tr: Kullanıcı bu rollerden birine sahip mi?

hadi-march/data#IconTile.name: IconTile
hadi-march/data#IconTile.doc: An icon in a tinted rounded square: `<IconTile icon={users} tone="primary" />`

props.name: color
props.doc: A theme colour token instead of a tone (`color="brand-orange"`, `cat-3`…).

props.name: variant
props.doc: "soft" (default: tinted ground), "outline" (framed, plain ground) or "solid" (filled).

props.name: shape
props.doc: "square" (default, rounded) or "round".

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name; without it the tile is decorative.

props.name: children
props.doc: Own content instead of the icon.

hadi-march/data#IconTile.tr: Renkli yuvarlak köşeli karedeki simge: `<IconTile icon={users} tone="primary" />`

hadi-march/data#invalidate.name: invalidate
hadi-march/data#invalidate.doc: Refetch active queries whose key starts with `prefix` (string or array prefix). Clears matching cache entries.
hadi-march/data#invalidate.tr: Anahtarı `prefix` ile başlayan etkin sorguları yeniden getirir (dize veya dizi öneki). Eşleşen önbellek kayıtlarını temizler.

hadi-march/data#JsonView.name: JsonView
hadi-march/data#JsonView.doc: Collapsible read-only JSON tree: `<JsonView value={obj} open={1} />` (open = initially expanded depth).

props.name: open
props.doc: Initially expanded depth (default 1).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your own texts: `{ items, keys, circular }`.

props.name: arrow
props.doc: The open / close arrow: true (default), false, or `(open) => node` (`open()` is live).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the tree.

hadi-march/data#JsonView.tr: Daraltılabilir salt okunur JSON ağacı: `<JsonView value={obj} open={1} />` (open = başlangıçta açık derinlik).

hadi-march/data#Kanban.name: Kanban
hadi-march/data#Kanban.doc: Board with columns and draggable cards.

props.name: card
props.doc: Card content for an item.

props.name: onMove
props.type: (item: T, from: string, to: string) => void
props.doc: Called when a card is dropped on another column (drag and drop; keyboard: Alt+← / Alt+→ on a focused card).

props.name: dot
props.doc: The dot before a column title: true (default), false, or `(column) => node`.

props.name: count
props.doc: The card count of a column: true (default), false, or `(column) => node`.

props.name: animate
props.doc: Cards scale in when they appear (default true).

hadi-march/data#Kanban.tr: Sütunlar ve sürüklenebilir kartlardan oluşan pano.

hadi-march/data#KeyValue.name: KeyValue
hadi-march/data#KeyValue.doc: Definition list for detail views: `<KeyValue items={[{ label: "Email", value: user.email }]} columns={2} />` or an object.

props.name: items
props.type: MaybeFn<readonly KeyValueItem[] | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined>
props.doc: Rows, or an object (keys become labels).

props.name: empty
props.doc: Shown for null / "" values (default "—").

hadi-march/data#KeyValue.tr: Ayrıntı görünümleri için tanım listesi: `<KeyValue items={[{ label: "Email", value: user.email }]} columns={2} />` veya bir nesne.

hadi-march/data#ListRow.name: ListRow
hadi-march/data#ListRow.doc: `<ListRow lead={home} title="Home" sub="Overview" trail={<Badge count={3} />} href="/" active />`, `<ListRow as="li" role="option" aria-selected={on} title={cmd.title} trail={<Kbd keys="mod+k" />} />`

props.name: lead
props.doc: Lead slot: an icon of hadi-march/icons, short text (emoji), or a node (Avatar, StatusDot, an image).

props.name: title
props.doc: The main line: text (scrolls when it does not fit) or a node. Children work too.

props.name: sub
props.doc: The second line: text or a node.

props.name: trail
props.doc: Trail slot inside the row: Badge, Kbd, Chevron, a time, a count.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Controls that act on the row (IconButton…). Beside a link / button row (never nested in it); at the end of a plain row.

props.name: href
props.doc: Makes the row a link (the router's Link when the app has a router).

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Makes the row a button; with `as`, a click listener on that element.

props.name: as
props.doc: Element of a row that is not a link or a button (default "div"): "li" for an option, "span" inside your own button, "label", "article" for a tile. "button": a button whose host listens itself (drag handle, pointer and key listeners) instead of `onClick`.

props.name: titleAs
props.doc: Element of the title (default a span): "h3" … for a tile whose title is a heading. A heading wraps instead of scrolling.

props.name: subAs
props.doc: Element of the sub text (default a span): "p" for a paragraph under a heading.

props.name: direction
props.doc: "row" (default: lead beside the text) or "column" (a tile: lead above the text, the trail under it).

props.name: active
props.doc: The current row (this page, the highlighted option): tinted. A link also gets `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: selected
props.doc: A chosen row. Said as `aria-pressed` on a button, `aria-checked` / `aria-selected` with a matching `role`.

props.name: interactive
props.doc: Hover look and pointer for a plain row whose host handles the click (a listbox option). Links and buttons have it.

props.name: size
props.doc: xs (a status bar item, a dense strip) · sm · md (default) · lg.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour token of the active / selected tint (default: the accent).

props.name: align
props.doc: Vertical alignment of lead and trail: "center" (default) or "start" (rows with long wrapped text). In a column: "start" (default) or "center" (a centred tile).

props.name: overflow
props.doc: Text that does not fit: "scroll" (default: OverflowText), "ellipsis", or "wrap".

props.name: marquee
props.doc: Options of the scrolling text (`{ mode: "loop", speed: 60 }`).

props.name: indicator
props.doc: A bar at the start edge of the active row (default false).

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Native tooltip (the HTML `title` attribute; the `title` prop is the main line).

hadi-march/data#ListRow.tr: Listelerin ortak satırı: baş yuva (ikon, avatar, nokta) + başlık + alt metin + son yuva; `href` ile bağlantı, `onClick` ile düğme ya da rol / aria alan düz öge: `<ListRow lead={home} title="Home" trail={<Badge count={3} />} href="/" active />`.

hadi-march/data#mutation.name: mutation
hadi-march/data#mutation.doc: A write operation. Returns an async function with `pending()` and `error()` signals.
hadi-march/data#mutation.signature: function mutation<V = void, R = unknown>(fn: (vars: V) => R | PromiseLike<R>, opts: MutationOptions<V, R> = {}): Mutation<V, R>
hadi-march/data#mutation.tr: Yazma işlemi. `pending()` ve `error()` sinyalleriyle bir eşzamansız işlev döndürür.

hadi-march/data#query.name: query
hadi-march/data#query.doc: Reactive async data. `fn` may read signals: it re-runs when they change (previous request aborted). A string is a URL fetched as JSON (and used as the key).
hadi-march/data#query.signature:
function query<T = unknown>(url: string, opts?: QueryOptions<T>): Query<T>
function query<T>(fn: QueryFn<T>, opts?: QueryOptions<T>): Query<T>
hadi-march/data#query.tr: Reaktif eşzamansız veri. `fn` sinyalleri okuyabilir: değişince yeniden çalışır (önceki istek iptal edilir). Dize, JSON olarak getirilen bir URL'dir (anahtar da odur).

hadi-march/data#resource.name: resource
hadi-march/data#resource.signature: const resource: (fn: QueryFn<T>, opts?: Omit<QueryOptions<T>, "key">) => Query<T>

hadi-march/data#setAccess.name: setAccess
hadi-march/data#setAccess.doc: Replace the access state (call after sign-in / sign-out / token refresh).
hadi-march/data#setAccess.signature: function setAccess(v: AccessInput | null | undefined): void
hadi-march/data#setAccess.tr: Erişim durumunu değiştirir (oturum açma / kapatma / belirteç yenilemeden sonra çağırın).

hadi-march/data#StatTile.name: StatTile
hadi-march/data#StatTile.doc: `<StatTile value="128" label="Posts" />`, `<StatTile value={<Counter value={$n} />} label="Followers" variant="tile" onClick={open} />`

props.name: value
props.doc: The figure: text, a number or a node (`<Counter value={n} />`).

props.name: label
props.doc: What it counts ("Followers").

props.name: hint
props.doc: A small line under them ("last 30 days").

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour token for the value (and the hover / focus of a clickable stat).

props.name: align
props.doc: start · center (default) · end.

props.name: size
props.doc: sm · md (default) · lg · xl.

props.name: variant
props.doc: plain (default) · tile (soft background) · card (border and surface).

props.name: order
props.doc: Which line comes first: "value" (default) or "label".

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Makes it a button.

props.name: href
props.doc: Makes it a link (the router's Link when the app has a router).

props.name: term
props.doc: Render `<dt>` (label) and `<dd>` (value, hint) for a `<dl>` parent; ignored for a button or a link.

props.name: hintIn
props.doc: Where the hint goes: "tile" (default: its own line, last) or "value" (inside the value element: one `<dd>` per term).

props.name: emphasis
props.doc: "figure" (default): the value is a heavy number · "text": the value reads as body text that wraps (a details list).

props.name: partClass
props.doc: An extra class on a part, for a host that keeps its own class names (the KPI box of hadi-march/charts): `{ value, label, hint }`.

hadi-march/data#StatTile.tr: Değer + etiket karosu (isteğe bağlı alt not); değer bir düğüm de olabilir, `onClick` ile düğme, `href` ile bağlantı olur: `<StatTile value="128" label="Posts" variant="tile" />`.

hadi-march/data#Timeline.name: Timeline
hadi-march/data#Timeline.doc: `<Timeline items={[{ time, title, body, tone, icon }]} />` — time may be a Date/epoch/ISO (formatted) or text.

props.name: dot
props.type: boolean | ((item: TimelineItem, index: number) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The dot of every item: true (default), false, or `(item, index) => node`.

props.name: line
props.doc: The line that connects the items (default true).

props.name: formatTime
props.doc: Your own text for a time value (default: Date / epoch / ISO are formatted as date and time, text stays).

hadi-march/data#Timeline.tr: `<Timeline items={[{ time, title, body, tone, icon }]} />` — time Date/epoch/ISO (biçimlendirilir) ya da metin olabilir.

hadi-march/data#timePercent.name: timePercent
hadi-march/data#timePercent.doc: Position of a time on a ruler of `duration` ms, as a CSS percentage (0–100%): rows under the ruler use the same scale.
hadi-march/data#timePercent.signature: function timePercent(ms: number, duration: number): string
hadi-march/data#timePercent.tr: Bir zamanın `duration` ms'lik cetveldeki yerini CSS yüzdesi olarak verir (%0–%100); cetvelin altındaki satırlar aynı ölçeği kullanır.

hadi-march/data#TimeRuler.name: TimeRuler
hadi-march/data#TimeRuler.doc: `<TimeRuler duration={2000} value={$now} onSeek={(ms) => playback.seek(ms)} />`, `<TimeRuler duration={() => span()} value={() => runner.elapsed()} minor={false} />` (read-only)

props.name: duration
props.doc: Time shown across the ruler, ms.

props.name: value
props.doc: Playhead position, ms; null / undefined: no playhead.

props.name: onSeek
props.doc: Makes the ruler draggable and the playhead a slider: called with the time to jump to.

props.name: onSeekStart
props.doc: A drag or a key press starts (pause playback here).

props.name: step
props.doc: Minor tick distance, ms (default: picked for the duration).

props.name: major
props.doc: Labelled tick distance, ms (default: picked for the duration).

props.name: minor
props.doc: Unlabelled ticks between the labels (default true).

props.name: ticks
props.doc: Own ticks instead of the computed ones.

props.name: format
props.doc: Label of a major tick (default "1.5s").

props.name: valueText
props.doc: Spoken value of the playhead (default "1.50 s").

props.name: snap
props.doc: Round a dragged time (snap to frames, to a grid); the pointer event tells the modifier keys.

props.name: keyStep
props.doc: Time one arrow key moves the playhead, ms (default 100; Shift: ten times).

props.name: head
props.doc: The playhead: true (default, when `value` is given), false, or your own grip node.

props.name: headClass
props.doc: Extra class of the playhead (a host that styles or finds it by its own name).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour token of the playhead (default: the accent).

props.name: labels
props.type: { ruler?: string | undefined; playhead?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Own names: the ruler and the playhead.

hadi-march/data#TimeRuler.tr: Zaman çizelgesinin üstündeki cetvel: tikler, zaman etiketleri ve oynatma başı; `onSeek` verilirse sürüklenir ve baş bir kaydırıcı olur: `<TimeRuler duration={2000} value={$now} onSeek={seek} />`

hadi-march/data#timeTicks.name: timeTicks
hadi-march/data#timeTicks.doc: Ticks for a duration: a minor tick every `step` ms and a labelled one every `major` ms (both picked for the duration when not given: at most ~40 ticks and ~8 labels). `timeTicks(2000)` → 0, 50, 100 … with a label every 250 ms.
hadi-march/data#timeTicks.signature: function timeTicks(duration: number, o: { step?: number | undefined; major?: number | undefined; minor?: boolean | undefined } = {}): TimeTick[]

params.name: o
params.type: { step?: number | undefined; major?: number | undefined; minor?: boolean | undefined }

hadi-march/data#timeTicks.tr: Bir süre için cetvel tiklerini üretir: her `step` ms'de ara tik, her `major` ms'de etiketli tik (verilmezse süreye göre seçilir).

hadi-march/data#Tree.name: Tree
hadi-march/data#Tree.doc: Expandable tree (role=tree; ↑ ↓ move, → opens then enters, ← closes then leaves, Enter selects): `<Tree nodes={files} onSelect={…} />`

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Tree").

props.name: chevron
props.type: boolean | ((node: TreeNode, open: () => boolean) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The open / close arrow: true (default), false, or `(node, open) => node` (`open()` is live; yours does not turn by itself).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the selected row (theme token; default: the accent).

hadi-march/data#Tree.tr: Genişletilebilir ağaç (role=tree; ↑ ↓ gezinir, → açar, ← kapatır, Enter seçer): `<Tree nodes={files} onSelect={…} />`

hadi-march/data#VirtualList.name: VirtualList
hadi-march/data#VirtualList.doc: `<VirtualList items={$posts} key={(p) => p.id} render={(p) => <PostCard post={p} />} onEndReached={loadMore} />`

props.name: key
props.type: ((item: T, index: number) => string | number) | undefined
props.doc: Stable row key (default: the index).

props.name: render
props.doc: Draws a row; `item` is an accessor that follows updates of the same key.

props.name: estimate
props.doc: Height guess (px) for rows not measured yet. Default 120.

props.name: overscan
props.doc: Extra pixels kept rendered above and below the viewport. Default 600.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space between rows (px). Default 0.

props.name: scroll
props.doc: self: the list scrolls (give it a height) · parent: the nearest scrolling ancestor. Default self.

props.name: onEndReached
props.doc: Called once per item count when the viewport is within `endDistance` of the end (infinite scroll).

props.name: endDistance
props.doc: Default 800 px.

props.name: header
props.doc: Before the rows (inside the scroll area).

props.name: footer
props.doc: After the rows: a loader, "no more" …

hadi-march/data#VirtualList.tr: `<VirtualList items={$posts} key={(p) => p.id} render={(p) => <PostCard post={p} />} onEndReached={loadMore} />` — sanallaştırılmış liste.

hadi-march/schema#fieldType.name: fieldType
hadi-march/schema#fieldType.doc: Register a custom field type: `fieldType("iban", { coerce, check, empty })`.
hadi-march/schema#fieldType.signature: function fieldType(name: string, def: Partial<FieldTypeDef>): void
hadi-march/schema#fieldType.tr: Özel bir alan türü kaydeder: `fieldType("iban", { coerce, check, empty })`.

hadi-march/schema#schema.name: schema
hadi-march/schema#schema.doc: Create a schema. The value type is inferred from the spec (`Infer<typeof S>`); declare pick `options` `as const` to get a literal union. Field options: type, label, required, min, max (number value or text length), minLength, maxLength, pattern (RegExp), options (pick/multi), default, help, placeholder, readonly, hidden, column (false | column overrides), format, currency, validate(value, values) → message|null, when(values) → bool (conditional field).
hadi-march/schema#schema.signature: function schema<S extends SchemaSpec>(spec: S, opts?: SchemaOptions<Infer<S>>): Schema<Infer<S>>
hadi-march/schema#schema.tr: Şema oluşturur. Değer türü tanımdan çıkarılır (`Infer<typeof S>`); sabit birleşim türü için seçim `options` değerini `as const` ile bildirin. Alan seçenekleri: type, label, required, min, max (sayı değeri veya metin uzunluğu) vb.

hadi-march/schema#TYPES.name: TYPES
hadi-march/schema#TYPES.doc: Field types and their base behaviour. Extend with `fieldType(name, def)`.
hadi-march/schema#TYPES.value:
{
  text: { coerce: str, empty: "" },
  textarea: { coerce: str, empty: "" },
  password: { coerce: str, empty: "", hidden: true },
  email: { coerce: (v) => (v == null ? "" : String(v).trim()), empty: "", check: (v: string) => (/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v) ? null : t`Enter a valid email address`) },
  url: { coerce: (v) => (v == null ? "" : String(v).trim()), empty: "", check: (v: string, f) => (/^https:\/\/[^\s]+$/.test(v) || (!f.httpsOnly && /^http:\/\/[^\s]+$/.test(v)) ? null : t`Enter a valid https:// address`) },
  phone: { coerce: (v) => (v == null ? "" : String(v).replace(/[^\d+]/g, "")), empty: "", check: (v: string) => (/^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$/.test(v) ? null : t`Enter a valid phone number`) },
  number: { coerce: num, empty: null },
  int: { coerce: (v) => { const n = num(v); return n == null ? null : Math.trunc(n); }, empty: null, check: (v: unknown) => (Number.isInteger(v) ? null : t`Enter a whole number`) },
  money: { coerce: num, empty: null, format: (f) => ["money", f.currency ?? "USD"] },
  percent: { coerce: num, empty: null, format: () => ["percent", 1] },
  bool: { coerce: (v) => v === true || v === "true" || v === "on" || v === 1, empty: false },
  date: { coerce: dateStr, empty: null, format: () => "date" },
  datetime: { coerce: (v) => (v == null || v === "" ? null : new Date(v as string).toISOString()), empty: null, format: () => "datetime" },
  time: { coerce: str, empty: "", check: (v: string) => (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(v) ? null : t`Use HH:MM`) },
  pick: { coerce: (v) => v, empty: null, check: (v: unknown, f) => (options(f).some((o) => o.value === v) ? null : t`Choose one of the options`) },
  multi: { coerce: (v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v : v == null || v === "" ? [] : [v]), empty: [], check: (v: unknown[], f) => (v.every((x) => options(f).some((o) => o.value === x)) ? null : t`Choose from the options`) },
  list: { coerce: (v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(String).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : String(v ?? "").split(/[\n,]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)), empty: [] },
  json: { coerce: (v) => { if (typeof v !== "string") return v; if (!v.trim()) return null; try { return JSON.parse(v) as unknown; } catch { return { __invalid: v }; } }, empty: null, check: (v: { __invalid?: unknown } | null) => (v && v.__invalid !== undefined ? t`Invalid JSON` : null) },
  color: { coerce: str, empty: "", check: (v: string) => (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v) ? null : t`Use a #RRGGBB color`) },
  file: { coerce: (v) => v ?? null, empty: null },
  hidden: { coerce: (v) => v, empty: null },
}
hadi-march/schema#TYPES.tr: Alan türleri ve temel davranışları. `fieldType(name, def)` ile genişletilir.

hadi-march/ui#accent.name: accent
hadi-march/ui#accent.doc: The current app accent ("primary" = the theme's own).

hadi-march/ui#ACCENT_CHOICES.name: ACCENT_CHOICES
hadi-march/ui#ACCENT_CHOICES.doc: Accent choices shown by the picker (default: the theme's primary, the HADİ colors and the semantic colors).
hadi-march/ui#ACCENT_CHOICES.tr: Seçicinin gösterdiği vurgu seçenekleri (varsayılan: temanın birincil rengi, HADİ renkleri ve anlamsal renkler).

hadi-march/ui#AccentPicker.name: AccentPicker
hadi-march/ui#AccentPicker.doc: Accent menu for a top bar: `<AccentPicker />` next to `<ThemePicker />`.
hadi-march/ui#AccentPicker.tr: Üst çubuk için vurgu menüsü: `<ThemePicker />` yanında `<AccentPicker />`.

hadi-march/ui#accepts.name: accepts
hadi-march/ui#accepts.doc: True when `file` matches an <input accept> list ("image/*", ".pdf", "text/csv"); an empty list takes all.
hadi-march/ui#accepts.signature: function accepts(file: { name?: string; type?: string }, accept: string | null | undefined): boolean
hadi-march/ui#accepts.tr: `file`, bir <input accept> listesiyle ("image/*", ".pdf", "text/csv") eşleşirse true; boş liste her şeyi kabul eder.

hadi-march/ui#Accordion.name: Accordion
hadi-march/ui#Accordion.doc: `<Accordion items={[{ title: "Shipping", content: … }]} multiple />` — animated height, ↑ ↓ Home End between headers.

props.name: chevron
props.type: boolean | unknown | ((open: () => boolean, item: AccordionItem) => unknown)
props.doc: The arrow at the end of a header: true (default), false, an icon / text, or `(open, item) => node` (open is live).

props.name: animated
props.doc: false: panels open and close at once, the arrow does not turn (default true).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the header icons (default: the accent).

props.name: onToggle
props.doc: Called when a section opens or closes.

hadi-march/ui#Accordion.tr: `<Accordion items={[{ title: "Shipping", content: … }]} multiple />` — animasyonlu yükseklik, başlıklar arasında ↑ ↓ Home End.

hadi-march/ui#action.name: action
hadi-march/ui#action.doc: With `reason`, `fn` receives the reason string as its last argument; `run()` takes the arguments before it.
hadi-march/ui#action.signature:
function action<A extends unknown[], R>(label: MaybeFn<string>, fn: (...args: [...A, string]) => R, opts: ActionOptions<A, Awaited<R>, [...A, string]> & { reason: number | ReasonOptions }): Action<A, Awaited<R>>
function action<A extends unknown[], R>(label: MaybeFn<string>, fn: (...args: A) => R, opts?: ActionOptions<A, Awaited<R>>): Action<A, Awaited<R>>
hadi-march/ui#action.tr: `reason` ile `fn` gerekçe dizesini son bağımsız değişken olarak alır; `run()` ondan önceki bağımsız değişkenleri alır.

hadi-march/ui#ActionButton.name: ActionButton
hadi-march/ui#ActionButton.doc: Render an action() as a button: hidden when the user may not run it, disabled while busy, confirm/reason/toasts handled by the action. `<ActionButton action={remove} args={[row]} variant="danger" size="sm" />`
hadi-march/ui#ActionButton.signature: function ActionButton<A extends unknown[], R>(props: ActionButtonProps<A, R>): () => unknown

props.name: action
props.doc: An action() object, or a plain `{ label, run }`.

props.name: run
props.doc: Runs instead of `action.run` (same arguments), e.g. a table's bulk run that clears the selection afterwards.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token of the button (see Button).

props.name: spinner
props.doc: The busy spinner: true (default), false, or your own node / icon (see Button).

props.name: shape
props.doc: See Button.

props.name: iconOnly
props.doc: Only the icon; the label becomes the aria-label.

hadi-march/ui#ActionButton.tr: Bir action()'ı düğme olarak çizer: kullanıcı çalıştıramıyorsa gizlenir, meşgulken devre dışı kalır, onay/gerekçe/bildirimleri action yönetir. `<ActionButton action={remove} args={[row]} variant="danger" size="sm" />`

hadi-march/ui#ActivityBar.name: ActivityBar
hadi-march/ui#ActivityBar.doc: `<ActivityBar items={[{ id: "files", label: "Files", icon: files }, …]} value={$view} onChange={(v) => $view = v} controls="side" />`

props.name: value
props.doc: The active view id, or null when the side view is collapsed.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Choosing the active view again collapses it (default true).

props.name: controls
props.doc: id of the element the views are shown in (aria-controls).

props.name: indicator
props.doc: The line that marks the active view (default true).

props.name: motion
props.doc: How the indicator moves to a new view: "glide" (default), "fade" (it appears in place) or "none".

props.name: tooltips
props.doc: Name tooltips on hover and focus (default true; the accessible name stays either way).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token of the active view and the indicator (default: the theme's primary).

hadi-march/ui#ActivityBar.tr: `<ActivityBar items={[{ id: "files", label: "Files", icon: files }, …]} value={$view} onChange={(v) => $view = v} controls="side" />`

hadi-march/ui#addBottomRightControl.name: addBottomRightControl
hadi-march/ui#addBottomRightControl.doc: Put a control into the bottom-end corner.
hadi-march/ui#addBottomRightControl.signature: function addBottomRightControl(node: Node, order: number = 0): (() => void)
hadi-march/ui#addBottomRightControl.tr: Alt-son köşeye (soldan sağa yazıda sağ alt) bir denetim koyar; kaldıran işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#addControls.name: addControls
hadi-march/ui#addControls.doc: Add nodes (a node or a list) to a region at increasing order from `base`.
hadi-march/ui#addControls.signature: function addControls(api: LayoutApi, region: LayoutRegion, nodes: unknown, base: number = 10): void
hadi-march/ui#addControls.tr: Bir bölgeye sıra numarasıyla düğüm ya da düğüm listesi ekler (`base` ile başlar).

hadi-march/ui#addCornerControl.name: addCornerControl
hadi-march/ui#addCornerControl.doc: Put a control into a corner, kept in `order` (lower = nearer the edge). Returns off(); inside a component it is also taken out when the component goes away.
hadi-march/ui#addCornerControl.signature: function addCornerControl(corner: Corner, node: Node, order: number = 0): () => void
hadi-march/ui#addCornerControl.tr: Dört köşeden birine (`top-start`, `bottom-end`…) bir denetim koyar; kaldıran işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#addDays.name: addDays
hadi-march/ui#addDays.doc: An ISO date n days later (negative: earlier).
hadi-march/ui#addDays.signature: function addDays(iso: IsoDate, n: number): IsoDate
hadi-march/ui#addDays.tr: n gün sonrasının (negatifse öncesinin) ISO tarihi.

hadi-march/ui#addMonths.name: addMonths
hadi-march/ui#addMonths.doc: An ISO date n months later; the day is clamped to the month's length.
hadi-march/ui#addMonths.signature: function addMonths(iso: IsoDate, n: number): IsoDate
hadi-march/ui#addMonths.tr: n ay sonrasının ISO tarihi; gün, ayın uzunluğuna sınırlanır.

hadi-march/ui#affix.name: affix
hadi-march/ui#affix.doc: Wrap a control with prefix / suffix text when given.
hadi-march/ui#affix.signature: function affix(props: AffixProps, el: Node): unknown
hadi-march/ui#affix.tr: Verildiyse bir denetimi ön ek / son ek metniyle sarar.

hadi-march/ui#Alert.name: Alert
hadi-march/ui#Alert.doc: `<Alert tone="warn" title="Heads up" dismissable onDismiss={…}>Body</Alert>`, `<Alert tone="danger" action={<Button size="sm">Retry</Button>}>…</Alert>` (alias Notice).

props.name: action
props.doc: The next step: a node, a list of nodes or `action()` objects (drawn as small buttons).

props.name: actionPlacement
props.doc: Where the actions sit: "end" (default: beside the text, before the dismiss button) or "below" the text.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the dismiss button (default "Dismiss", translated).

props.name: dismissIcon
props.doc: Glyph or node inside the dismiss button (default: the × glyph).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token instead of the tone's colours ("brand-purple", "cat-3"…); the role still follows `tone`.

props.name: variant
props.doc: "soft" (default: the tone's tinted fill) or "raised": a floating message (a toast) on the surface of a layer with a shadow; the tone colours the icon alone.

props.name: role
props.doc: The ARIA role instead of the tone's ("alert" for danger and warn, "status" otherwise).

props.name: partClass
props.type: { icon?: string; body?: string; dismiss?: string } | undefined
props.doc: Extra classes of the parts (the host's own hooks): the icon, the body, the dismiss button.

hadi-march/ui#Alert.tr: `<Alert tone="warn" title="Heads up" dismissable onDismiss={…}>Body</Alert>` (takma ad Notice).

hadi-march/ui#ansi.name: ansi
hadi-march/ui#ansi.doc: ANSI helpers for command output: `io.print(ansi.green("hazır"))`; colors, bold, dim, italic, underline, strip.
hadi-march/ui#ansi.signature: const ansi: { black: (s: string) => string; red: (s: string) => string; green: (s: string) => string; yellow: (s: string) => string; blue: (s: string) => string; magenta: (s: string) => string; cyan: (s: string) => string; white: (s: string) => string; gray: (s: string) => string; brightRed: (s: string) => string; brightGreen: (s: string) => string; brightYellow: (s: string) => string; brightBlue: (s: string) => string; brightMagenta: (s: string) => string; brightCyan: (s: string) => string; bold: (s: string) => string; dim: (s: string) => string; italic: (s: string) => string; underline: (s: string) => string; strip: (s: string) => string; }
hadi-march/ui#ansi.valueType: { black: (s: string) => string; red: (s: string) => string; green: (s: string) => string; yellow: (s: string) => string; blue: (s: string) => string; magenta: (s: string) => string; cyan: (s: string) => string; white: (s: string) => string; gray: (s: string) => string; brightRed: (s: string) => string; brightGreen: (s: string) => string; brightYellow: (s: string) => string; brightBlue: (s: string) => string; brightMagenta: (s: string) => string; brightCyan: (s: string) => string; bold: (s: string) => string; dim: (s: string) => string; italic: (s: string) => string; underline: (s: string) => string; strip: (s: string) => string; }
hadi-march/ui#ansi.tr: Komut çıktısı için ANSI yardımcıları: `io.print(ansi.green("hazır"))`; renkler, kalın, soluk, eğik, altı çizili, strip.

hadi-march/ui#AppShell.name: AppShell
hadi-march/ui#AppShell.doc: Application frame: a sidebar (usually <NavMenu/>) and the main area. Desktop: sticky sidebar column + scrolling main. Narrow screens: a slim top bar with the menu button (the NavMenu becomes a drawer) and full-width main. `<AppShell nav={<NavMenu items={…} />} top={<UpdateBanner/>} header={<TopBar/>} features={{ readingProgress: true }}>…</AppShell>`
hadi-march/ui#AppShell.tr: Uygulama çerçevesi: kenar çubuğu (genelde <NavMenu/>) ve ana alan. Masaüstü: yapışkan kenar çubuğu sütunu + kayan ana alan. Dar ekranlar: menü düğmeli ince üst çubuk (NavMenu çekmeceye dönüşür) ve tam genişlikte ana alan.

hadi-march/ui#argsOf.name: argsOf
hadi-march/ui#argsOf.doc: Read the `args` prop of a component that runs actions (ActionButton, Menu).
hadi-march/ui#argsOf.valueType: <A extends readonly unknown[]>(props: { args?: Args<A>; }) => A
hadi-march/ui#argsOf.tr: Eylem çalıştıran bir bileşenin (`ActionButton`, `Menu`) `args` prop'unu okur: liste ya da listeyi veren erişimci.

hadi-march/ui#askReason.name: askReason
hadi-march/ui#askReason.doc: Ask why the user is doing something (audited actions). Text must be at least `min` characters. With `purposes: [{value,label}]` a purpose must be chosen too and the result is `{ category, text }`. Resolves null when cancelled.
hadi-march/ui#askReason.signature:
function askReason(opts: AskReasonOptions & { purposes: readonly Purpose[] }): Promise<ReasonWithPurpose | null>
function askReason(opts?: AskReasonOptions & { purposes?: undefined }): Promise<string | null>
function askReason(opts?: AskReasonOptions): Promise<string | ReasonWithPurpose | null>
hadi-march/ui#askReason.tr: Kullanıcıya bir şeyi neden yaptığını sorar (denetlenen eylemler). Metin en az `min` karakter olmalıdır. `purposes: [{value,label}]` ile bir amaç da seçilmelidir ve sonuç `{ category, text }` olur. İptal edilirse null döner.

hadi-march/ui#AuthLayout.name: AuthLayout
hadi-march/ui#AuthLayout.doc: Split sign-in screen: a branded showcase panel (gradient mesh, grid, highlights) and a focused form column. `<AuthLayout brand={<Brand …/>} title="Sign in" subtitle="…" aside={{ headline, text, points }}>…form…</AuthLayout>`

props.name: aside
props.type: { headline?: unknown; text?: unknown; points?: readonly { icon?: unknown; title: unknown; text?: unknown }[]; foot?: unknown }
props.doc: Showcase side (wide screens): a headline, a short pitch and highlight rows.

hadi-march/ui#AuthLayout.tr: Bölünmüş giriş ekranı: markalı vitrin paneli (gradyan ağ, ızgara, öne çıkanlar) ve odaklı form sütunu. `<AuthLayout brand={<Brand …/>} title="Sign in" subtitle="…" aside={{ headline, text, points … }}>`

hadi-march/ui#autoHideHeaderFeature.name: autoHideHeaderFeature
hadi-march/ui#autoHideHeaderFeature.doc: The header slides away while scrolling down and comes back on the way up (more room on small screens).
hadi-march/ui#autoHideHeaderFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: aşağı kaydırınca üst bar gizlenir, yukarı kaydırınca geri gelir.

hadi-march/ui#Avatar.name: Avatar
hadi-march/ui#Avatar.doc: `<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" src={url} size="sm|md|lg" />` — initials when there is no image or it fails.

props.name: text
props.doc: Ready text instead of the initials ("+3", "?").

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon (or node) instead of the initials when there is no image.

props.name: color
props.doc: A fixed theme colour instead of the colour taken from the name.

props.name: shape
props.doc: "circle" (default) or "square" (rounded).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default: the name, or "Avatar").

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Hidden from screen readers (the name is written next to it).

props.name: loading
props.doc: How the image loads (default "lazy").

props.name: children
props.doc: Own content instead of the image / initials.

hadi-march/ui#Avatar.tr: `<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" src={url} size="sm|md|lg" />` — görsel yoksa veya yüklenemezse baş harfler.

hadi-march/ui#AvatarGroup.name: AvatarGroup

props.name: max
props.doc: Avatars shown before "+N" (default 4).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the group (default "N people").

props.name: more
props.doc: The "+N" bubble: true (default), false, or `(rest) => content`.

props.name: spacing
props.doc: "overlap" (default) or "gap": avatars side by side.

props.name: color
props.doc: One theme colour for every avatar (a person's own `color` wins).

hadi-march/ui#AvatarGroup.tr: "+N" ile üst üste binen avatarlar: `<AvatarGroup names={["Ada", "Linus", …]} max={4} />`

hadi-march/ui#bootLoader.name: bootLoader
hadi-march/ui#bootLoader.doc: Boot loader: the app's index.html shows a static `#hm-boot` element; call `bootLoader.done()` once the app rendered.
hadi-march/ui#bootLoader.signature: const bootLoader: { done({ id, fade }?: { id?: string; fade?: number; }): boolean; }
hadi-march/ui#bootLoader.valueType: { done({ id, fade }?: { id?: string; fade?: number; }): boolean; }
hadi-march/ui#bootLoader.tr: Açılış yükleyicisi: uygulamanın index.html'i statik bir `#hm-boot` öğesi gösterir; uygulama çizilince `bootLoader.done()` çağırın.

props.name: value
props.doc: Active item id.

props.name: onCreate
props.doc: Shows the raised Create button in the middle. With `createActions` it runs on a long press (the default action).

props.name: createActions
props.doc: The Create button opens a menu of these actions (new post, story, live…). Live.

props.name: createMenu
props.doc: Look of the Create menu: "fan" (round buttons on an arc, default), "stack" (pills above the button) or "sheet" (a list from the bottom).

props.name: createTitle
props.doc: Title of the Create menu (the sheet's heading and the menu's name). `false`: no heading (the menu keeps its name).

props.name: createHandle
props.doc: The grab handle on top of the "sheet" menu. Default true.

props.name: onAction
props.doc: Called with the action a person picked (after its own `run`).

props.name: ring
props.doc: Ring colors of the Create button: color tokens ("brand-orange", "primary" …) or CSS colors; `false`: no ring. Default: the four HADİ colors (a theme's brand tokens first).

props.name: bubble
props.doc: The colored bubble behind the active tab. Default true; `false`: the active tab is marked by its color only.

props.name: motion
props.doc: Motion (bubble slide, icon pop, button bounce, ring turn, menu fly-out). Default true; `false`: everything changes at once.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Show labels under the icons. Default true (the label stays the accessible name either way).

props.name: variant
props.doc: floating: a rounded bar with room around it · flat: edge to edge. Default floating.

props.name: tint
props.doc: brand: each tab's own color · accent: the theme accent for all. Default brand.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

hadi-march/ui#bottomRightControls.name: bottomRightControls
hadi-march/ui#bottomRightControls.tr: Alt-son köşenin öğesi (soldan sağa yazıda sağ alt).

hadi-march/ui#BottomRightControls.name: BottomRightControls
hadi-march/ui#BottomRightControls.doc: The bottom-end corner (right in LTR, left in RTL).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the corner group (default "Page controls").

hadi-march/ui#BottomRightControls.tr: Alt-son köşeyi yerinde çizer; eklenen denetimler buraya gelir.

hadi-march/ui#Brand.name: Brand
hadi-march/ui#Brand.doc: Logo lockup: `<Brand mark={logo} name="HADİ" sub="Admin" href="/" />`

props.name: mark
props.doc: The mark: an icon (hadi-march/icons, e.g. one made with defineIcon), text or a node.

props.name: sub
props.doc: Small second line (product / environment).

hadi-march/ui#Brand.tr: Logo bloğu: `<Brand mark={logo} name="HADİ" sub="Admin" href="/" />`
